purpose: Validate a complete or incremental Stage 3-3-2 UnityFS exact-runtime-path scan without reopening frozen Skin identity, ownership, sourceOrder, or model-resource selection. Final freeze admission is allowed only after all catalog-confirmed candidate bundles are accounted for and every required target has an accepted exact-evidence class.

qaClasses.RESOLVED_EXACT_SINGLE_BUNDLE: Exactly one catalog-confirmed bundle contains exactly one exact full runtime-path occurrence.
qaClasses.RESOLVED_EXACT_IDENTICAL_CAB_ALIAS: More than one catalog-confirmed bundle contains the exact runtime path, every hit occurs once, and every matched embedded CAB is byte-identical by SHA-256. Preserve all provenance; do not infer begin/current ownership.
qaClasses.PENDING_UNSCANNED_CANDIDATE: At least one catalog-confirmed candidate bundle for this target has not been scanned yet.
qaClasses.FAIL_NOT_FOUND: All catalog-confirmed candidates were scanned and no exact full runtime-path occurrence was found.
qaClasses.REVIEW_DUPLICATE_OCCURRENCE_IN_BUNDLE: An exact runtime path occurs more than once inside one scanned candidate; exact path bytes alone are insufficient to collapse occurrences.
qaClasses.REVIEW_MULTIPLE_NONIDENTICAL_CABS: The exact runtime path occurs in multiple candidate bundles but matched embedded CAB SHA-256 values are not all identical.
qaClasses.FAIL_SCAN_ERROR: One or more required candidate bundles failed UnityFS/CAB scanning.
qaClasses.FAIL_CANDIDATE_COVERAGE: The target has no authoritative catalog-confirmed candidate bundle or the frozen candidate surface changed.
qaClasses.FAIL_INVALID_SCAN_EVIDENCE: The scan result violates frozen counts, identity, or evidence invariants.
